status_policy.purpose: Illustrative performance thresholds, not data-error thresholds or approved institutional targets.
status_policy.missing: No baseline only for no earlier quarter; gaps and zero baselines are Unavailable with a reason. Unexpected missing values are Unavailable: Missing value.
status_policy.watch_limit_unit: Same unit as the metric; differences between percentage rates are percentage points.

validation.expected_na: Only first-observation revenue growth, expense growth and recycling-rate change without an earlier baseline.
validation.failure_action: Investigate source records and calculation lineage before relying on the affected KPI.
validation.unavailable: Consecutive-quarter comparisons only; a period gap or zero growth baseline is UNAVAILABLE with an explicit reason, not a fabricated growth value.
